title: Isolation of Single Somas from Postmortem Fresh Frozen Human Brain and Immunostaining for AT8 and MAP2
author: Marcos Otero-Garcia
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6uqhevw
materials: Add primary antibodies ( Ms-a-AT8 1:150 and Rb-a-MAP2 1:40 ) and incubate on a shaker in cold room ( 4 °C ) for 00:40:00 . Use Eppendorfs coated with BSA for collection (to coat the Eppendorf tubes, fill them with 10% BSA solution in PBS for 00:05:00 , rinse with PBS, and dry at 4 °C overnight).
Add secondary antibodies ( G-a-Ms Alexa350, 1:500 and G-a-Rb Alexa647, 1:500 ) and Sytox Green 1:400 (1:100 stock, final concentration 1:40.000 )

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the homogenization buffer and pre-cool the equipment on ice.

substeps.instruction: Cool homogenization buffer on ice.
Pre-cool a Potter-Elvehjem tissue grinder (8 mL tubes, 0.1–0.15 mm clearance space between pestle and tubes) on ice.

steps.title: Homogenize Brain Tissue
steps.instruction: Process the brain tissue to release somas using a dounce tissue grinder.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.4 mL of homogenization buffer to the pre-cooled dounce tissue grinder.
Collect a brain chunk (~200 mg) and transfer it to a Petri dish on ice.
Cut the tissue into small pieces using a chilled scalpel or blade.
Transfer all pieces into the dounce tissue grinder.
Slowly homogenize the tissue on ice (8–15 slow strokes).
Check the homogenate with a hemocytometer during processing; adjust strokes to avoid clumps (too few) or naked nuclei (too many).

steps.title: Filter and Concentrate Homogenate
steps.instruction: Remove debris and concentrate the somas via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Filter the homogenate through a 100 µm Corning cell strainer to remove clumps.
Take a sample for the hemocytometer.
Transfer the homogenate into two precooled 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Slowly aspirate the supernatant from the side of the tube, leaving up to 50 µL to avoid disturbing the pellets.

steps.title: Perform Iodixanol Gradient Separation
steps.instruction: Separate somas from debris using a density gradient.

substeps.instruction: Gently resuspend each pellet in 225 µL of cold homogenization buffer and pool both tubes (final volume 450 µL).
Add 450 µL of cold 42% v/v iodixanol to the suspension (Final iodixanol concentration: 21%).
Add 900 µL of 25% iodixanol into a 2 ml Eppendorf tube.
Slowly layer the 21% iodixanol suspension over the 25% iodixanol without mixing.
Centrifuge for 15 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Recover and Block Somas
steps.instruction: Isolate the soma pellet and block non-specific staining.

substeps.instruction: Remove and discard the top myelin-rich debris layer using a 1 ml pipette with a cut tip or cotton swabs.
Remove and discard the aqueous supernatant without disrupting the somas pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 200 µL of buffer for Antibody Incubation and transfer to a new tube.
Incubate for 15 minutes at 4 °C (or on ice) for blocking.

steps.title: Wash and Pool Somas
steps.instruction: Wash the somas and recover non-pelleted cells to maximize yield.

substeps.instruction: Take samples for the hemocytometer, unstained control, and 2AB-only (nonspecific binding control).
Add 500 µL of buffer for Immunostaining and invert several times.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Transfer all supernatant (including some pellet) to a new Eppendorf tube and resuspend the pellet in 400 µL of buffer for Antibody Incubation.
Centrifuge the collected supernatant for 5 minutes at 4 °C to recover non-pelleted somas.
Resuspend recovered somas in 200 µL of buffer for Antibody Incubation and pool for a final volume of 600 µL.

steps.title: Prepare for FACS Sorting
steps.instruction: Verify sample quality and transport to the FACS facility.

substeps.instruction: Take samples for single color staining.
Check quality on hemocytometer (expected: ~1-2 million somas in ~0.6 mL for 200 mg tissue).
Transfer to 7 ml culture tubes.
Place on ice and transport to the FACS facility with controls (Non-stained, 2AB only, Single stainings).

steps.title: Collect and Stabilize Sorted Cells
steps.instruction: Collect sorted cells into specialized medium and adjust BSA concentration.

substeps.instruction: Collect cells in BSA-coated Eppendorfs containing collection medium (volume should be ~1/5 of the expected final volume).
Add BSA after collection to reach a final concentration of 1% BSA.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the collection medium and antibody incubation buffer.

substeps.instruction: Prepare collection medium by mixing: 9400 µL RNase-free PBS (pH7.4), 500 µL RNase-free 10% BSA, 50 µL 1 M MgCl2, 10 µL DNAse I (2000 U/ml), 2955 µL IM1, 3 µL 1mM DTT, 30 µL 50x Protease Inhibitor, and 15 µL RNaseIN 40 U/µl.
Prepare buffer for Antibody incubation (1.5 ml per sample) by adding 5 µL of RNaseIN 40 U/µl to 1 mL of buffer for Immunostaining (final concentration 0.2U/µl).
